defects.description: The parent-segment check runs before percent-decoding, so an encoded ../ (%2e%2e/) passes the check, is decoded, and resolves outside the root.
defects.why_missed: The suite rejects a literal ../ and decodes a harmless %20; the defect is the order of two correct steps, which every individual test confirms.
defects.severity_rationale: A path traversal input crosses the root boundary with the default configuration.

detection_criteria.mechanism: The parent-segment check runs before percent-decoding, so an encoded ../ (%2e%2e/) passes the check, is decoded, and resolves outside the root.
detection_criteria.proof: Show an exploitable condition, or a concrete violation of a named security property (the input and the boundary it crosses).
